assertions.name: one_admission_per_observed_inbound_exchange
assertions.meaning: Each inbound exchange, identified independently by the client and the oracle, has exactly one internal admission. A fresh ExchangeId does not reset the count.

assertions.name: same_required_obligations_at_both_checkpoints
assertions.meaning: Both checkpoints hold the same obligations: DeliveryId, target SessionId, cause, effective QoS and payload reference. A count of two is not enough.

assertions.name: same_recipe_for_op_A
assertions.meaning: The canonical recipe stored for the operation bound as op_A is byte-identical at every observation.

assertions.name: no_positive_ack_before_confirmed_commit
assertions.meaning: No positive acknowledgement is eligible before the core received a confirmation or recovered a sufficient durable fact, even if the store had committed.

assertions.name: no_pubrec_observed_before_crash
assertions.meaning: The peer decoder observed no PUBREC of the exchange before the crash.

assertions.name: all_required_faults_hit
assertions.meaning: Every declared injection was reached exactly as many times as expected; otherwise the run is inconclusive.

assertions.name: trace_complete
assertions.meaning: The trace has its header, a gapless record sequence per origin and a footer declaring completeness.
